description: This file defines an abstract class ClientBusinessEvent, which extends AbstractBusinessEvent with Client as its generic type, representing business events related to clients within the system.

classes.name: ClientBusinessEvent
classes.description: An abstract class representing client-related business events, with a category of 'Client'. It provides implementations for retrieving the event category and the aggregate root ID.

methods.name: ClientBusinessEvent
methods.description: Constructor initializing the event with a Client instance.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of this event, which is 'Client'.

methods.name: getAggregateRootId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the client associated with this event.
